## Plugin reference

- Description: A decision's side chat, web half: a chat icon on the right of the answer's editor, beside the note's (a dot while the decision has a thread and the chat is closed), opening the chat above the answer box — the first question's box, then the agent's thread (AgentThread, its own reply box last, the answer field still below it) — on every surface a decision is answered in (the inbox, the conversation tray, the page block). One thread per decision: its task is filed about the decision (tasks/task-subject) under Decision questions, so it is found again after a reload. Nothing in it reaches the agent that asked. Registers the decision chat config with its model picker. A decision's side chat, server half: the decision chat config (the answering model, the agent's whole prompt as an editable template) and the Decision questions task category every side chat's task is filed under — its own, so a chat never lands in the asking agent's tree.
